items.title: ASCO 2026: Kelonia presents positive in vivo CAR-T data in multiple myeloma
items.summary: Early data suggest KLN-1010, now acquired by Eli Lilly, could be more tolerable but less efficacious that AstraZeneca’s ESOT-01.

items.title: ASCO26: In vivo oncology approaches continue to show promise
items.summary: Lilly’s $7bn acquisition of Kelonia seems to be bearing fruit, with other in vivo approaches showing promise at ASCO 2026.

items.title: ASCO26: Blood cancer readouts take centre stage
items.summary: Readouts in rare blood cancers like myelofibrosis, WM and CLL are attracting keen interest at this year’s ASCO conference.

items.title: Emerging therapies for CNS tumours: key clinical trial updates to watch at ASCO 2026
items.summary: At ASCO 2026, oral abstract presenters highlighted new and exciting central nervous system (CNS) tumour treatments.

items.title: ASCO 2026: Mixed SCLC result for Legend’s LB2102, Novartis expedites manufacture
items.summary: As Legend’s LB2102 trial in SCLC fails to dazzle, co-developer Novartis banks on quick manufacturing to find a commercial edge.
